description: This Java source file defines the 'ThingTooLargeException' class, a custom exception indicating that a 'Thing' (likely a data object in the system) exceeds the allowed size. It includes methods for constructing and deserializing the exception, as well as a builder class for fluent creation.

classes.name: ThingTooLargeException
classes.description: A final immutable exception class representing an error when a 'Thing' exceeds the maximum allowed size. It provides static methods for creating instances and deserialization, and contains an internal builder class for fluent instantiation.

classes.name: ThingTooLargeException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing 'ThingTooLargeException' instances with a fluent API, initialized with actual and maximum byte sizes, and used internally for exception creation.
